bridge that connects Telegram (WhatsApp, Zalo, Viber, ... ) to DeepSeek Harness via its headless CLI
Self-hosted **personal assistant** on DeepSeek Harness: Telegram + optional Web UI, local notes/repo
The bot allowlists Telegram users, runs the agent in an isolated `workspace/`, and keeps chat histor
y on disk. Headless mode boots `dsh` per message with a personal-assistant profile (no shell). SDK m
ode keeps a JSON-RPC runtime and resumes a real harness session.
**Data stays local** — `telegram-bridge/data/`, `workspace/`, and `~/.dsh/` are not pushed to GitHub
*Data stays local** — `telegram-bridge/data/`, `workspace/`, and `~/.dsh/` are not pushed to GitHub.

- Node.js 22.19+
- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in the repo-root `.env`
- Telegram bot token from @BotFather
Send `/whoami`, add your user id to `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS`, restart.

| `/note`, `/notes`, `/remember` | Personal notes and short memory (local files) |
| `/search`, `/re

ound tasks |
| `/export` | Zip local data and send as a document |
| `/newchat`, `/cancel`, `/status
Send a **text or PDF document** to ingest into `workspace/inbox/`.
Merge `config/providers/openrouter-provider.yaml` into `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` for the model catalog.
Web search uses **Tavily** only when explicitly requested (`tìm kiếm`, `/search`, `/report`, …). Kno
wledge answers stay short; search/report replies cite sources.
Set `DSH_MODE=sdk` and `DSH_SDK_LAUNCH` in `telegram-bridge/.env` when you have `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sd
k-client` and a JSON-RPC runtime. Gives persistent harness sessions per chat.
DeepSeek Harness is MIT-licensed by DeepSeek AI. This repository is MIT-licensed independently.
